_comment_project_name: No spaces — used as ChromaDB collection name. Use underscores.
_comment_token_chunking: Token chunking is more precise but MUCH slower (use false for large datasets)
_comment_url_for_sources_citation: Optional base URL for the online docs. When set, source links in chatbot responses point to the live documentation page. When omitted, sources show local file paths. Accepts either a single string for the whole module, or an object keyed by doc category — {"dev": "...", "user": "..."} — when the two doc sets are published under different paths, as SALOME does with /tui/ and /gui/. The page path relative to dev_path/user_path is appended, so pages nested in subdirectories keep distinct URLs.

embedding._comment_type: 'local' uses sentence-transformers locally. 'api' uses an OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint.
embedding._comment: Must match exactly the embedding config in chatbot/config.json — mismatch causes silent wrong retrieval
